scope: Primary-source research for pre-case bring-up; no supplier approval or stock reservation

Nordic_USB.locator: Manufacturer engineer: internal series termination; matched pair, 90 ohm differential for long tracks

USB_layout.locator: AN0046 rev1.0, PCB layout discussion; general reference, not an nRF52840 compliance result

charger.locator: SLUS810N pp11-13, 27-28: RthetaJA44.5 C/W, input limits, TS currents/thresholds, proportional dynamic timer, junction thermal regulation

regulator.locator: SLVS696D 9.2.2.3: input >=4.7uF recommended, VINA 0.1uF and <=0.22uF, nominal output10uF; does not qualify unspecified MPN bias derating

NTC.locator: AT series pp12-13: 103AT R25 10k +/-1%, B25/85 3435K +/-1%; nominal R/T column used directly, rather than extending a single beta approximation

cell.locator: HCP404074 bare-cell 2024 sheet: 3.0 V discharge cutoff; conflicting 1600mAh and 270/1350mA rate rows require corrected manufacturer limits

protection.locator: One-cell protection with external-NTC abnormal-temperature detection; not evidence that any generic PCM or a particular finished pack supplies the requested hot/cold interruption

PCM_vs_NTC.locator: Manufacturer separately describes PCM voltage/current functions and NTC sensing; neither phrase alone proves independent temperature interruption
